title: The Ice Guy and the Cool Girl
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Himuro, an office worker descended from a yuki-onna snow spirit, accidentally makes it snow or freezes things when his feelings run high, and he has a crush on his calm coworker Fuyutsuki, who does not notice. Their office includes other descendants of yokai, such as a fox-spirit coworker. Short, gentle chapters follow their slow workplace romance.
life_message: Being accepted for your quirks by kind people around you makes ordinary life warm.

content.note: Chaste adult office romance; MangaDex rates safe.

dominant: Gentle acceptance of difference; folklore heritage in modern office life
